item.title: Maybelline New York onboards Kiara Advani as its brand ambassador
item.description: Maybelline New York has onboarded Kiara Advani as its new brand ambassador for India. “Makeup, for me, is a form of self-expression. item.title: Mozilla’s anti-AI campaign asks users to choose their future
item.description: Mozilla has decided to pick a fight that most of Silicon Valley would rather declare settled. The non-profit tech organisation, widely known for its web browser Firefox, has rolled out a new brand campaign, Choose Your Future, positioning itself as a rare voice of scepticism in a browser market that is racing headlong into artificial intelligence. item.title: Luxury buyers value wellness, community over size: Godrej Properties
item.description: Would you pay extra for a dedicated pet lift in your residential building? India’s luxury homebuyers increasingly are. According to insights from a study conducted by Godrej Properties, 43% of respondents said they are willing to pay an additional Rs 10–20 lakh for features that offer added privacy and convenience. item.title: How Omnicom Advertising India is navigating leadership and trust after the IPG deal
item.description: Omnicom’s acquisition of IPG has raised familiar questions around leadership structure, strategic focus, and client trust amid continued consolidation among global agency holding companies. item.title: Zee appoints Sandeep Mehrotra as COO – advertisement revenue
item.description: Zee Entertainment Enterprises has appointed Sandeep Mehrotra as chief operating officer – advertisement revenue, effective 3 February 2026. He will be based in Mumbai and report to CEO Punit Goenka. In this role, Mehrotra will be responsible for strengthening the company’s advertisement revenue across its linear television and digital platforms, with a focus on integration between the two segments.
